description: Find tracks that appear in more than one of the given playlists (cross-playlist dupes). Quota: N GETs (one per playlist).

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

items.description: Playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or Spotify playlist URL; use this reference in the canonical or documented legacy field

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: find_duplicate_tracks_across_playlists
